Parking the roadmap. Your answer settles the open question from my last message (promote O2, re-order, or stop Track A), so nothing gets promoted.

**What parks.** Each of these becomes one item in `specs/deferred_items.md`, under `## lock-closures-roadmap — 2026-11-06`:

| Item | From | Done when |
|---|---|---|
| Closure notices | Stage 2 (Track B, unticked) | the notice job and its operator mailing list exist; in a test, an email reaches every address on the list within an hour of a new closure entry |
| 7-day closure-risk outlook per lock | Ranked list A, #1 (O2) | O2's outlook runs daily from the river-level forecast, with its findings file and the measured cost of its real run |
| Per-lock closure curves, pooled across all 14 locks | Ranked list A, #2 (O3) | O3's curves are fit on the real data, with its findings file and measured cost |
| Closure-history map for boat operators | Ranked list A, #3 (O4) | O4's map page exists |

Stage 1 is complete and stays as it is. Its findings stay in `specs/lock-closures-stage-1-findings.md`, and each Track A item will point to that file, so a revival starts from the 3.1 m threshold and the 22-minute, 1.8 GB cost. Stage 2's text-message notices never had a stage or list item, so nothing parks for them.

**Steps I'll run:**

```
Read  ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/<deferred-backlog reference>   # exact Deferred-item schema
Read  specs/deferred_items.md                                       # create it if absent; append, never overwrite
Edit  specs/deferred_items.md        # append the dated section with the 4 items, each self-contained with Size: and Done when:
Edit  specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md # add under the header: "PARKED (2026-11-06) — 1 of 2 stages complete. Funding for the canal study ended."
Bash  git mv specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
Bash  git add specs/deferred_items.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
Bash  git commit -m "Park lock-closures roadmap (1 of 2 stages complete); defer Stage 2 and Track A ranked items"
```

Planned sizes: Stage 2 is small (one closure-log poll every 10 minutes), O2 is small once O1's model exists, O3 is medium (about 14 times Stage 1's 1.8 GB), and O4 is about a day. I'll set the final `Size:` values to fit the schema's scale once I've read it.

**Two notes:**
- This roadmap has no spec, so there are no methodology or critique files to retire with it.
- The findings file stays in `specs/` rather than moving to `specs/completed/`, because the deferred items cite it. Tell me if you'd rather it moved too.

I'll commit on `main` and then stop. Once parked, nothing hands off to a next stage.
